race_title: Proof of Hunt - source failure verification
note: Every source here is chosen for one property above all others: it does not change. Standards documents that were frozen on publication, a 1989 proposal kept as a historical record, and specification files that have not been touched in years. A clue whose page drifts does not produce a wrong verdict - it produces UNDETERMINED and costs the player nothing - but it does waste consensus, so drift is designed out rather than handled.
authoring_rules: The anchor must never contain the answer. It is public in the clue view, so an anchor that leaks the answer turns the clue into a giveaway.
The anchor sits immediately before the material, because the window runs forward from it.
The answer pattern is checked on chain before any model is called. It is the cheap filter that keeps the answer space near binary and stops a player burning tribunal budget on an essay.

The source URL is public. It has to be - it is on chain, and claiming otherwise would be a claimed-behaviour mismatch. The race is about solving faster with the same information, not about privileged information.

clues.title: By Air
clues.riddle: A 1990 memo specifies the transmission of IP datagrams by pigeon. It gives a typical maximum transmission unit, and the unit of measure is not bytes. Give the number only.
clues.hint: Milligrams. And it is a power of two.
